usedFor: Stripe holds customers, and “Send Message” in SOLAPI reaches them through your SOLAPI account when “Customer Subscribes”.

bestTemplate.name: “Customer Subscribes” in Stripe, then “Send Message” in SOLAPI
bestTemplate.why: A new subscriber gets a confirmation message sent through your SOLAPI account.

watchOut: A message reaching a customer waits in Needs you for your approval before “Send Message” goes out.
